name: Denmark
notes: Folketing: 179 seats = 175 in Denmark proper (135 constituency seats in ten multi-member constituencies by D'Hondt + 40 levelling seats allocated nationally by unmodified Sainte-Lague to parties over 2% or holding a constituency seat) plus 4 North Atlantic mandates (2 Faroe Islands, 2 Greenland, elected separately). Validated: national Sainte-Lague reproduces the 24 March 2026 result exactly (S 38, SF 20, V 18, LA 16, DF 16, M 14, KF 13, EL 11, RV 10, DD 10, ALT 5, BP 4) and the 2022 result within two seats. The map shows the ten storkredse with their 2026 result (Danmarks Statistik; DAGI boundaries via data.information.dk) and colours each by its projected winner. Polling tracked after the 2026 election; the next election is due by 2030.
